---
title: Two-Phase Combined Plots
output: html_notebook
---



This is an R code to average across wings.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(matrixStats)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(msm)


#

Genotype <- " "    # Enter genotype name

# 

Genotype

yf_initial <- 0.70
alpha_initial_fast <- 0.02
alpha_initial_slow <- 0.0001
percentage_fast_initial <- 70

Plots <- read_csv("Two-phase Average Intensities for Plot.csv")
Plots


Combined_Results <- read_csv("Two-phase Combined Results.csv")
Combined_Results

G <- as.data.frame(ddply(Plots, .(t), summarize, y_ave = mean(y)))
G


augmented_plots <- Plots %>% nest(-Name) %>% mutate(fit = map(data, ~nls(y ~ yf * percentage_fast * 0.01 * (1- exp(-alpha_fast * t)) + yf * (100 - percentage_fast) * 0.01 * (1-exp(-alpha_slow * t)), start = list(yf = yf_initial, percentage_fast = percentage_fast_initial, alpha_fast = alpha_initial_fast, alpha_slow = alpha_initial_slow), control = list(maxiter = 500, printEval = TRUE, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1/4096), algorithm = "port", lower=c(0,0,0,0), upper=c(100,100,100,100), data=.)), augmented = map(fit, augment), ) %>% unnest (augmented)

#augmented_plots <- Plots %>% group_by(Name) %>% do(fit = nls(y ~ yf * (1- exp(-alpha * t)), start = list(yf = yf_initial, alpha = alpha_initial), control = list(maxiter = 500, printEval = TRUE, warnOnly = TRUE), data=.)) %>% augment(fit)


AU <- Plots %>% nest(-Name) %>% mutate(fit = map(data, ~nls(y ~ yf * percentage_fast * 0.01 * (1- exp(-alpha_fast * t)) + yf * (100 - percentage_fast) * 0.01 * (1-exp(-alpha_slow * t)), start = list(yf = yf_initial, percentage_fast = percentage_fast_initial, alpha_fast = alpha_initial_fast, alpha_slow = alpha_initial_slow), control = list(maxiter = 500, printEval = TRUE, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1/4096), lower=c(0,0,0,0), upper=c(100,100,100,100), data=.)), tidied = map(fit, tidy), ) %>% unnest(tidied) %>% select(Name, term, estimate) %>% spread(term, estimate)

#AU <- Plots %>% group_by(Name) %>% do(fit = nls(y ~ yf * (1- exp(-alpha * t)), start = list(yf = yf_initial, alpha = alpha_initial), control = list(maxiter = 500, printEval = TRUE, warnOnly = TRUE), data=.)) %>% tidy(fit) %>% select(Name, term, estimate) %>% spread(term, estimate)

AU
qplot(t, y, data = augmented_plots, geom = 'point', color = Name) + geom_line(aes(y=.fitted)) + ylab("Normalised Intensity") + xlab("Time (s)") + labs(title= "Two-phase exponential fits of averaged normalised intensities of each wing") + theme_minimal()
augmented_plots
summary(augmented_plots)

AU_mutated <- AU %>% mutate("Time Constant Fast" = 1/alpha_fast, "Time Constant Slow" = 1/alpha_slow, "Half-Life Fast" = log(2, exp(1))/alpha_fast, "Half-Life Slow" = log(2, exp(1))/alpha_slow)
AU_mutated


my_sum_plot <- Plots %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
 dplyr::summarise(n=n(),
            mean = mean(y),
            sd = sd(y, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(se = sd/sqrt(n)) %>%
  mutate(ic=se*qt((1-0.05)/2 + .5, n-1))
my_sum_plot

se <- function(t) sd(t)/n(t)
se




augmented_ave_fit <- nls(y_ave ~ ymax * percentage_fast * 0.01 * (1- exp(-alpha_fast * t)) + ymax * (100 - percentage_fast) * 0.01 * (1-exp(-alpha_slow * t)), start = list(ymax = yf_initial, percentage_fast = percentage_fast_initial, alpha_fast = alpha_initial_fast, alpha_slow = alpha_initial_slow), control = list(maxiter = 500, printEval = TRUE, warnOnly = TRUE, minFactor = 1/4096), algorithm = "port", lower=c(0,0,0,0), upper=c(100,100,100,100), data = G)

joined <- merge(my_sum_plot, augment(augmented_ave_fit))
joined

qplot(t, y_ave, data=joined) + geom_point(color="mediumseagreen") + geom_line(aes(y=.fitted), color="mediumseagreen", ) + ylab("Average Normalised Intensity") + xlab("Time(s)") + labs(title= "Two-phase exponential fit of average normalised intensity") + theme_minimal() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=t, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), linetype = "twodash", color = "darkgrey") + ylim(0,1.2)


##
library(ggplot2)
library(nlme)
library(mgcv)
library(investr)

PRED1 <- predFit(augmented_ave_fit, interval = "confidence")
PRED1
joined <- cbind(joined, PRED1)
joined

qplot(t, y_ave, data=joined, geom = 'point', color = Genotype) + geom_point(aes(color = Genotype,size=3)) + geom_line(aes(y=.fitted, color = Genotype,size=3)) + ylab("Average Normalised Intensity") + xlab("Time(s)") + labs(title= "One-phase exponential fit of average normalised intensity") + theme_minimal(base_size = 60)  + ylim(0,1.2)  +  geom_line(aes(y=lwr), linetype=8, size=1) + geom_line(aes(y=upr), linetype=8,size=1) 

##




summary(augmented_ave_fit)
AU_fit <- tidy(augmented_ave_fit) %>% select(., term, estimate) %>% spread(term, estimate)
AU_fit

SUM <- tidy(augmented_ave_fit) %>% select(Estimate = estimate, Standard_Error = std.error, p_value = p.value)
SUM

ymax_all <- AU_mutated$yf
ymax_ave <- AU_fit$ymax

print(paste("Finding the average between wings, the mean y_max is:", ymax_ave))


t_test_yf <- tidy(t.test(ymax_all, mu = ymax_ave))
t_test_yf

percentage_fast_all <- AU_mutated$percentage_fast
percentage_fast_ave <- AU_fit$percentage_fast

print(paste("Finding the average between wings, the mean percentage_fast is:", percentage_fast_ave))

t_test_percentage_fast <- tidy(t.test(percentage_fast_all, mu = percentage_fast_ave))
t_test_percentage_fast


alpha_all_slow <- AU_mutated$alpha_slow
alpha_all_fast <- AU_mutated$alpha_fast
alpha_ave_slow <- AU_fit$alpha_slow
alpha_ave_fast <- AU_fit$alpha_fast
print(paste("The mean fast rate constant, α_fast, is:", alpha_ave_fast, "s^-1."))

t_test_alpha_fast <- tidy(t.test(alpha_all_fast, mu = alpha_ave_fast))
t_test_alpha_fast

print(paste("The mean slow rate constant, α_slow, is:", alpha_ave_slow, "s^-1."))
t_test_alpha_slow <- tidy(t.test(alpha_all_slow, mu = alpha_ave_slow))
t_test_alpha_slow

tau_all_fast <- AU_mutated$`Time Constant Fast`
tau_ave_fast <- 1/alpha_ave_fast
print(paste("The average fast time constant, τ_fast, is:", tau_ave_fast, "s."))


t_test_tau_fast <- tidy(t.test(tau_all_fast, mu = tau_ave_fast))
t_test_tau_fast

tau_all_slow <- AU_mutated$`Time Constant Slow`
tau_ave_slow <- 1/alpha_ave_slow
print(paste("The average slow time constant, τ_slow, is:", tau_ave_slow, "s."))


t_test_tau_slow <- tidy(t.test(tau_all_slow, mu = tau_ave_slow))
t_test_tau_slow

half_life_all_fast <- AU_mutated$`Half-Life Fast`
half_life_ave_fast <- log(2, base=exp(1))/alpha_ave_fast

print(paste("The average fast half-life is:", half_life_ave_fast, "s."))

t_test_half_life_fast <- tidy(t.test(half_life_all_fast, mu = half_life_ave_fast))
t_test_half_life_fast

half_life_all_slow <- AU_mutated$`Half-Life Slow`
half_life_ave_slow <- log(2, base=exp(1))/alpha_ave_slow

print(paste("The average slow half-life is:", half_life_ave_slow, "s."))

t_test_half_life_slow <- tidy(t.test(half_life_all_slow, mu = half_life_ave_slow))
t_test_half_life_slow


comb_res <- read_csv("Two-phase Combined Results.csv")
Stable_Am <- comb_res %>% select(Name, Stable_Amount, Unstable_Amount)
Stable_Am
 group_by(Stable_Am, Name) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(Stable_Amount, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
res.aov <- aov(Stable_Amount ~ Name, data = Stable_Am)
summary(res.aov)
TukeyHSD(res.aov)

Summary_of_values <- data.frame(c("Genotype", "Fast Rate Constant", "Slow Rate Constant", "ymax", "Percentage_fast", "Fast Time Constant", "Slow Time Constant", "Fast Half-Life", "Slow Half-Life"),
                                c(Genotype,
                         print(paste(format(alpha_ave_fast, digits = 3), "s^-1")),
                              print(paste(format(alpha_ave_slow, digits = 3), "s^-1")),
                         print(paste(format(ymax_ave, digits = 3))),
                         print(paste(format(percentage_fast_ave, digits = 3))),
                         print(paste(format(tau_ave_fast, digits = 3), "s")),
                          print(paste(format(tau_ave_slow, digits = 3), "s")),
                         print(paste(format(half_life_ave_fast, digits = 3), "s")),
                           print(paste(format(half_life_ave_slow, digits = 3), "s"))),
                         c("95% confidence intervals",
                           print(paste("[", format(t_test_alpha_fast$conf.low, digits = 3), ",", format(t_test_alpha_fast$conf.high, digits=3), "]")),
                           print(paste("[", format(t_test_alpha_slow$conf.low, digits = 3), ",", format(t_test_alpha_slow$conf.high, digits=3), "]")),
                           print(paste("[", format(t_test_yf$conf.low, digits = 3), ",", format(t_test_yf$conf.high, digits=3),"]")),
                            print(paste("[", format(t_test_percentage_fast$conf.low, digits = 3), ",", format(t_test_percentage_fast$conf.high, digits=3),"]")),
                           print(paste("[", format(t_test_tau_fast$conf.low, digits = 3), ",", format(t_test_tau_fast$conf.high, digits=3),"]")),
                           print(paste("[", format(t_test_tau_slow$conf.low, digits = 3), ",", format(t_test_tau_slow$conf.high, digits=3),"]")),
                           print(paste("[", format(t_test_half_life_fast$conf.low, digits = 3), ",", format(t_test_half_life_fast$conf.high, digits=3), "]")),
                           print(paste("[", format(t_test_half_life_slow$conf.low, digits = 3), ",", format(t_test_half_life_slow$conf.high, digits=3), "]"))))
print(Summary_of_values)

Stable <- Stable_Am %>% select(Name, "Amount" = Stable_Amount) %>% mutate(Type = "Stable")
Unstable <- Stable_Am %>% select(Name, "Amount" = Unstable_Amount) %>% mutate(Type = "Unstable")
Name <- Stable_Am$Name



Chart <- rbind(Stable, Unstable)
Chart


ggplot(Chart, aes(x=Name, y=Amount, fill = Type)) + geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity")  + xlab("Name") + ylab("Amount") + theme_minimal() + ggtitle(paste("Stable and unstable amounts", "\n", Genotype)) 

my_sum_stable <- Chart %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n=n(),
            mean = mean(Amount),
            sd = sd(Amount, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(se = sd/sqrt(n)) %>%
  mutate(ic=se*qt((1-0.05)/2 + .5, n-1))
my_sum_stable
N <- my_sum_stable$n[1]


ggplot(my_sum_stable, aes(x=Type, y=mean, fill = Type)) + geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity")  + xlab("Name") + ylab("Amount") + theme_minimal() + geom_errorbar(aes(x=Type, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean+se), width = 0.4) + ggtitle(paste("Average stable and unstable amounts", "\n", Genotype, "\n", "n =", N, "wings"))



summary(augmented_ave_fit)
confint(augmented_ave_fit, level=0.95)

```
